text:
marta: Hey — I'm OOO starting 22:00 and my MFA token expires at 23:45. We have the midnight release scheduled. Who can actually press if deploy-bot needs a human approval? @ops-oncall? :wave:

ops-oncall: I can take the pager but my YubiKey is at home. If someone needs JIT sudo we need people-ops to grant temp role or use breakglass.

ben-o: I can press, but I don't have prod-deployer role currently. @people-ops can you grant `temp-deployer` until ~01:30? I can monitor metrics and rollback if needed.

people-ops: For JIT we need the standard ticket + an approver in eng-release. Create the ticket and tag approver. We try not to do exceptions past midnight but ok in emergencies.

alex: I can be the approver for this window but want the release pinned and a rollback plan pre-made. Please pin the artifact and create a rollback tag before anyone presses.

deploy-bot: preflight summary: artifacts: available ✓
canary: healthy ✓ (last 10m errors 0.2%)
policy: manual-approve required for role `prod-deployer`
notes: MFA verification needed at time of press.

samir: If people-ops turnaround is slow, we can run breakglass (audit + postmortem) but prefer the JIT route so logs and roles are clean.

alex: Plan: 1) people-ops opens ticket #JIT-4321 and grants `temp-deployer` to ben-o until 01:30. 2) Pin artifact: `v2.3.12-prod` (sha `abc1234`). 3) Create rollback tag `rollback/v2.3.11`. 4) Run a 15m canary smoke after press. Commands to pin and tag:
```
# pin artifact
ci-tool pin --env prod --artifact v2.3.12-prod --sha abc1234
# create rollback tag
git tag -a rollback/v2.3.11 -m "rollback point before v2.3.12" abc9876
```

people-ops: Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIT-4321. Granting `temp-deployer` to ben-o from 23:50–01:30. Adding MFA exception window and audit owner = alex. Please confirm in thread.

marta: Approved. alex, you're the sign-off — thanks for covering. ben-o, pls confirm you have monitoring dashboards ready and rollback playbook open.

ben-o: Confirmed. Dashboards up, rollback playbook pinned. I'll press and watch metrics. Starting deploy once people-ops completes grant. `/deploy prod v2.3.12 --pin`

deploy-bot: action: manual-approval-pending for `prod-deployer`

ben-o: people-ops shows role granted. pressing now.

deploy-bot: started deploy job #deploy-9876 — streaming logs at https://ci.redwood/reports/deploy-9876

ben-o: Canary looks clean at +10m. No error spikes. Keeping watch until 00:45 then will promote. Rollback tag ready if needed. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all. Document the JIT grant in the ticket and link audit log. I'll run retrospective if anything odd.

marta: appreciate the handoff — safe night everyone! :sleeping:
